name: DroneHunter F700 net interceptor
description: Reusable radar-guided multirotor interceptor that captures Group 1-2 UAS with a tethered net or DrogueChute. First Replicator 2 purchase, Jan 2026. 5 km air-vehicle range.

minRangeM.condition: minimum engagement range — no public figure; representative launch-and-climb distance before a net shot is possible

maxAltitudeFt.condition: engagement altitude ceiling — UNKNOWN. Fortem states only that the F700 does 'not fly at the same high altitudes of larger drones'.

engageTimeS.condition: assignment-to-effect time — DERIVED, not published. Arithmetic: reported speed is above 100 km/h, i.e. about 27.8 m/s. Full envelope 5,000 m / 27.8 m/s = 180 s. A typical intercept nearer 3,500 m gives 3,500 / 27.8 = 126 s; adding about 20 s for launch, climb and radar lock gives 146 s, rounded to 150 s. Fortem states the aircraft 'launches in seconds', which is consistent with the 20 s allowance.
engageTimeS.source: DroneHunter Counter Unmanned Aerial System (C-UAS), US

pk.condition: 85 percent success rate on mid-air captures

salvoCooldownS.condition: reloaded for back-to-back sorties in under 3 minutes (180 s)
